meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 当用户需要操作 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 时，Claude 可协助选择实验方案（蛋白表达纯化、定量、IVT RNA、热稳定性、Echo-MS、SPR、像素画等），准备输入文件（FASTA、CSV 等），并引导完成订购流程。
howto.when: 当用户提出要运行 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验，例如蛋白表达、定量、IVT、热稳定性、Echo-MS、SPR 或像素画时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交一个细胞-free HiBiT 蛋白表达实验。
say.note: 选择该方案并开始配置参数和上传序列。

say.text: 我想做 IVT mRNA 合成，qPCR 检测。
say.note: 选择 IVT mRNA 合成方案并填写样本信息。

say.text: 帮我在 EstiMate 上评估一个自定义实验的价格。
say.note: 使用 EstiMate 进行可行性评估。

howto.what_en: Claude helps users select, configure, and submit protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, quantification, IVT RNA, thermal shift, Echo-MS, SPR, and fluorescent pixel art. It assists with protocol choice, input preparation, and ordering workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run experiments on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, such as protein expression/quantification, IVT, thermal shift, Echo-MS, SPR, or pixel art.

say_en.text: Submit a cell-free HiBiT protein expression experiment.
say_en.note: Selects that protocol and starts configuration.

say_en.text: I want to do IVT mRNA synthesis with qPCR readout.
say_en.note: Chooses IVT mRNA synthesis protocol and fills in details.

say_en.text: Estimate feasibility and price for a custom workflow on EstiMate.
say_en.note: Uses EstiMate for custom protocol assessment.
